title: Second Minimum Time to Reach Destination
goal: Find the second distinct travel time from vertex one to vertex n.
strategy: Uniform edge times and synchronized signals make arrival time depend only on hop count. BFS retains two distinct smallest hop counts per vertex, then simulates red-light waits for the second destination count.
